  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the redirect-handling block, so redirected pushes can leave redirect tokens or descriptor digits as spurious arguments.
  WHY: `git push origin HEAD:feature/open 2>&1` can be parsed with an unintended push target; reviewers also report the root copy is missing other claimed PR changes.

- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-266 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The template redirect-target handling does not skip a standalone `&` before clearing `redirect_target`.
  WHY: Redirects such as `2>&1` can leave the descriptor digit as a spurious push argument, causing the guard to evaluate an unintended destination.

- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:between lines 758-760 (absent) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The claimed `test_push_redirects_do_not_check_the_merged_checkout_branch` regression test is absent.
  WHY: The redirect parsing defect has no claimed regression coverage in the test file.

- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:103, 126-127 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root audit-plans command does not satisfy the byte-for-byte parity test with the template command.
  WHY: Reviewers agree `test_template_parity` fails and CI is blocked; they disagree on whether the command files are absent or present with mismatched wording.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:1275-1278 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The codex preflight exits before checking whether the Claude engine is resolved for the SECURITY_AUDIT role.
  WHY: An environment with Claude configured but without codex on PATH terminates instead of proceeding to `claude_run_selected SECURITY_AUDIT`.

  confidence=[5]

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
